title: Robotic Surgery Reached 15.1%—And Built A $7.1 Billion Industry
hook: Robotic surgery reached 15.1% and became a $7.1 billion industry.
closing: Robots moved from operating-room novelty toward routine care patients increasingly encounter.
question: Would you trust robotic surgery?

segments.say: Robotic procedures rose 98 percent. A specialized tool became mainstream surgery.
Robots handled 15.1 percent of general surgeries. The method was no longer rare.
Robotic-surgery revenue reached 7.1 billion dollars. Hospital adoption created a major industry around the operating room.
